title: vivo V80 in for review
description: This is the vivo V80, yes, the same V80 we handled earlier this month. Well, different unit; this one is Green (or is it Blue?). We're torn whether it's a green shade of blue or a blue shade of green. Either way, it's much nicer (and original) than the iPhone shade of orange we handled last time. This global model ships in a box with a transparent soft case, a 90W charger, and a USB-A to USB-C cable. Unboxing the vivo V80 Design-wise, the vivo V80 sits in the middle between its predecessor, the V70, and a recent iPhone Pro. It's built like the V70 with a matte metal frame...

title: Deals: latest Galaxy foldables and Galaxy S26 series are on sale
description: Last week, we covered Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days and then the aftermath – some phones kept their promotional prices from the Prime sale even during the weekend, while others went back up. Checking back again on them this week, we see that all phones now cost more. That is on Amazon, anyway, so we went over to see what Walmart has to offer. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 is currently $1,700 on Amazon, while it was $1,650 last week (this is for a 12/256GB unit). Walmart has it at $1,640, though, so it’s not too late to pick one up. title: Qualcomm denies rumors about Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheating
description: Yesterday, a Korean news outlet shared some concerning news about the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra. According to the report, Samsung is thinking about going all Exynos next year, as internal testing has shown that the newly released Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset is running too hot, resulting in thermal throttling. In contrast, the Exynos 2700 is doing just fine. But after the rumor did its rounds on the internet, Qualcomm's CMO responded to a thread on X saying that these rumors were inaccurate. title: Honor Win2 runs AnTuTu too, its cooling fan helps it achieve a top score
description: Honor is launching the Win2 in China on October 21, and not long ago it was purportedly spotted in the Geekbench online database, confirming the fact that it will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC. Now a prototype device with the same BRM-AN00 model number has also run AnTuTu v12, managing to score 5,702,964, as the image below attests. The phone has a 1,502,737 CPU score, a 2,072,221 GPU score, a 755,729 memory score, and a 1,372,277 UX score. title: Moto G47 Power is coming with a much larger battery than the G47
description: Motorola launched the Moto G47 in April, and interestingly, the company is now readying not a successor, but a new member of the Moto G47 family - the Moto G47 Power. title: If you haven't pre-ordered an iPhone Duo yet, you're in for a long, long wait
description: The Apple iPhone Duo is available for pre-order starting today – or rather we should say that it was available. The very limited supply became painfully apparent when mere hours after launching, Apple’s online store was already showing a shipping date of January 22. The original plan was for the iPhone Duo to start shipping on October 23 after a week of pre-orders. And some people will surely get theirs on that date, but most Duo buyers are in for a wait. description: According to new MIIT (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) listings in China, the Samsung Galaxy S27+ will miss out on a connectivity feature that has been around since the days of the Galaxy S21+, and that's UWB. The Galaxy S27 series is expected to include 4 phones: Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra. The MIIT listing reveals all four models, but only the Pro and the Ultra are listed to support UWB. description: The Exynos 2700 reportedly beat the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 in internal benchmarks, outscoring it in multi-core Geekbench by around 10%. However, it may have another advantage – running cooler. In a flashback to the Snapdragon 8 Gen 1, the new Elite Extreme Gen 6 runs too hot for Samsung’s liking, according to industry insiders quoted by SEDaily. During testing of the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, Samsung found that the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 exceeded temperature thresholds and started throttling during heavy sustained loads. title: Sony bails on Xperia 10 VI’s Android 17 update
description: The Xperia 10 VI launched in May of 2024, booting Android 14, and at the time Sony pledged the device would be eligible for three Android updates. That meant that it would get Android 17 at some point, but that promise will not be kept as Sony has now issued a notice to its users. As per Sony, the Xperia 10 VI will not be getting Android 17 due to “limitations related to the device’s storage configuration”.
